job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy generative AI models using Agentic AI platform.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate generative AI solutions into existing systems.
Develop high-quality prompts for various applications such as chatbots, voice assistants, and other conversational interfaces.
Troubleshoot issues related to generative AI model performance and provide recommendations for improvement.

Job Requirements :

5-9 years of experience in Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) development.
Strong understanding of Python programming language and its libraries (e.g., TensorFlow).
Experience with Prompt Engineering techniques for designing effective prompts for different use cases.
Familiarity with Agentic AI platform or similar tools for building generative AI models.
